_comment: Spec-shaped x402 v2 PaymentRequired served by the offline fixture origin. Shape derived from @x402/core PaymentRequired (dist/esm/client/index.mjs createPaymentPayload) and @x402/svm ExactSvmScheme (extra.feePayer required; extra.recentBlockhash short-circuits the RPC blockhash lookup). {{ORIGIN}} is replaced with the loopback origin at serve time. Addresses are deterministic 32-byte-fill stand-ins, not real wallets.
